invariants.description: i_stim is the exact rectangular pulse train: stim_flag i_stim_amplitude/Cm while t_start <= t <= t_end and (t - t_start) mod period <= pulse_duration, else 0 (samples within 1e-9 s of an edge excluded)
invariants.expr: (lambda N, i, t, s, e, P, d, a: N.all((N.abs(i - N.where((t >= s) & (t <= e) & (N.mod(t - s, P) <= d), a, 0.0)) <= 1e-9*max(abs(a), 1e-300)) | (N.minimum(N.mod(t - s, P), P - N.mod(t - s, P)) < 1e-9) | (N.abs(N.mod(t - s, P) - d) < 1e-9) | (N.abs(t - e) < 1e-9)))(np, i_stim, t, i_stim_start, i_stim_end, 1.0/i_stim_frequency, i_stim_pulse_duration, stim_flag*i_stim_amplitude/Cm)

bc_sweep.rationale: Pacing from 30 to 180 beats/min (0.33-2 s periods), pulses of 1-10 ms, amplitudes 0.1-2 nA and capacitances 50-200 pF bracket the Paci 2013 hiPSC-CM protocol (60 bpm, 5 ms, 0.55 nA, 98.7 pF). t_end = 1 s checks that pacing stops; stim_flag 0 checks the switch.

baseline.reason: prescribed stimulus waveform (an input, not a physiological response); verified against its exact analytic pulse train

calibrate.note: not_applicable: prescribed stimulus waveform (an input, not a physiological response); verified against its exact analytic pulse train
